Hero.role: Frontend developer specializing in Angular and React. My main focus is Angular development on a global platform used by NGOs and consultants worldwide — alongside a smaller, ongoing React role building aircraft-operations tooling for an aviation SaaS company.
Hero.copy: Originally trained as a biomedical engineer — a background that led me toward frontend work built around live, high-stakes data rather than static content.

About.title: About
About.p1: I started in biomedical engineering — a master's degree spent thinking about precision, tolerances and instruments. I moved into frontend development because I wanted to build the instruments myself.
About.p2: Since 2022 I've worked across SaaS, B2B and data-driven platforms in Angular and React. My primary focus has been Angular development on a large-scale data platform used by NGOs and consultants worldwide, alongside a smaller, ongoing React role building live monitoring tools for aviation operations.
About.p3: Based in Chișinău, Moldova — EU citizen, fully eligible to work remotely across the EU without sponsorship.
